overview: The Hollowshade Wetlands are the treacherous southern marshlands avoided by most tribal forces.
history: The wetlands formed from ancient subterranean springs.
Marsh totems were erected by forgotten tribes predating the Owlbears and Sonic Wolves.
Bog beasts emerged as dominant predators during early Luclin cycles.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, scouts reported increased marsh lurker activity.
Wetland shamans strengthened rituals tied to stagnant pools.
hooks: A marsh totem emits strange energy.
A swamp shaman requests aid with a ritual.
A marsh lurker nest is discovered near the trail.
